authority.cfl_xml_definition: JCaseCtes::ReadXmlDef reads the case definition constant
authority.cfl_xml_execution: JCaseCtes::ReadXmlRun reads the execution constants actually passed to the run
authority.cfl_cli: JSphCfgRun parses -cfl and JSph::LoadConfig applies the runtime override
authority.timestep: JSphCpu::DtVariable and JSphGpu::DtVariable multiply the limiting timestep by CFLnumber
authority.output: JSph::LoadConfigParameters reads TimeOut; JDsOutputTime/JDsSaveDt implement output scheduling

request_lineage.direct: A receipt request record may equal the source request path and SHA
request_lineage.forwarded: A root-forward receipt request must carry root_canonical_binding.source_request and source_sha256 equal to the exact source request record
request_lineage.missing_or_wrong_binding: FAIL; do not infer lineage from case labels or XML identity
request_lineage.actual_parent_request: Retain embedded receipt request identity separately from source request identity

half_cfl_requires: bound execution XML cflnumber difference or explicit receipt -cfl
half_output_requires: CFL and all timestep controls equal
